sentences.en: It was said that a great poet had resided here.
sentences.zh: 据说这里曾住过一位伟大的诗人。

sentences.en: Protons and neutrons reside in the nucleus of the atom.
sentences.zh: 质子和中子存在于原子核内。

sentences.en: The locals believe that a spirit resides in this tree.
sentences.zh: 当地人相信树里有精灵居住。

senses.zh: <正式>居住，定居；<正式>存在于；<正式>（权利、权力等）属于；位（于）
